Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Input image is the EXACT human-approved reveal A-r01 of the Chocolate Hills, Bohol. Derive ONE separate simplified colored motif illustration from that exact picture for a later roughly 36-column by 16-row nonogram. DO NOT create a puzzle grid, pixels, cells, numbers or clues.
Preserve the same panorama viewpoint, left-to-right order and relative positions/proportions of the hills: the largest foreground cone slightly left of center, a smaller foreground cone at left, a substantial foreground cone at right; the staggered line of smaller cones behind; the visible open green valley between the main center hill and the right hill. Keep the characteristic repeated smooth rounded conical hills and their grass-covered slopes. Preserve the whole scene, including the connecting land and valley relationships. Do not add new objects, change the viewpoint, or turn it into a single hill or jagged mountain range.
Simplification: replace every photographic grass strand, tiny shrub and leaf with LARGE coherent clean areas. Group the forest into a few calm rounded green bands; merge only tiny distant foliage details. Preserve the recognizable main hill silhouettes and the approximate positions of the distant cones. The three main hills must remain distinct, not joined into one ridge.
Use a flat, clearly hand-drawn 2D motif illustration with calm confident contours and broad solid regions, no texture, grain, gradients, realistic lighting or tiny isolated decorative dots. The picture must remain a simplified illustration, not a vector logo and not the final detailed reveal.
Use only these FOUR intended foreground colors in substantial connected regions: warm ochre brown #BF8545 for sunlit hills, deeper earth brown #805333 for shaded hill flanks and hill contours, olive green #91A25A for open valley/ground, dark forest green #3E6141 for grouped vegetation and green contours. No additional black outline, white paint, blue, yellow light color, or pale background. Use the darker brown or darker green for contours as appropriate. Flat broad shaded flanks, no fine hatching. Antialiased borders are fine; no false claim of exact raster colors.
Real PNG alpha transparency outside the land vignette and in the open sky; preserve the transparent exterior. Keep the compact organic landscape silhouette. No rectangle, glow, drop shadow, border, checkerboard or cut-earth slab. Make a WIDE COMPACT LANDSCAPE canvas approximately 9:4 (for example 1536 by 688), closely framing the full vignette with a small transparent margin; do not stretch the hills. The motif group should fill most of its canvas. No text, labels, grid or watermark.
